item.title: - Canonical Commutation Relation in Quantum Mechanics
item.description: Introduction to Canonical Commutation Relation # The canonical commutation relation is one of the fundamental principles in quantum mechanics, establishing the relationship between position and momentum operators. item.title: - Translation Operator
item.description: 1. Translational Symmetry in Space # The inner product between two states remains invariant under translation: $\langle\phi|\psi\rangle = \langle\phi|T^{\dagger}(\Delta x’)T(\Delta x)|\psi\rangle$ where $T(\Delta x’)|x’\rangle = |x’+\Delta x’\rangle$ Therefore, $T^{\dagger}(\Delta x’)T(\Delta x) = 1$ This means that $T(\Delta x’)$ is a unitary operator. 2.
